about_the_game:
Kingdom’s Path is a strategic 3D tower defense game with roguelite elements, where you build not only the path enemies follow, but also the map itself — shaping your kingdom tile by tile. Construct your kingdom, strengthen your defenses, and carve your own path to survival.

Define the Enemy's Path

      Use path cards to create and extend winding paths that direct enemy waves. The more you control the path, the more time you have to prepare your defenses. Every playthrough offers different path layouts and challenges.

Build and Grow Your Kingdom

      Place towers, mines, farms, lumber camps, and special buildings that generate resources or boost your defense. Your kingdom expands turn by turn with every path or structure you place, you reshape the world. You don’t just build paths, you construct the map itself, shaping your kingdom tile by tile and creating a unique world in every run.

Strategic Tower Combat

      Place and upgrade towers to defend your castle against incoming waves. Each tower type has unique effects (fire, ice, etc.) and can be enhanced by nearby buildings like armories or elemental shrines.

Roguelite - Replayability

      Choose a civilization and a leader at the start of each run, each with their own passive bonuses and unique buildings. Unlock new cards, towers, artifacts, and leaders as you progress and survive longer in each session.

Card-Based Building System

      Instead of unlimited placement, build using randomly drawn cards. Choose wisely each turn between expanding the path, building defenses, or boosting economy.
